title: The Latest Crier for Jan 21, 2026
items:
TWO SENATE SPOTS ARE OPEN

This spring, there are TWO Senate seats open. Applications are open this morning and will close FRIDAY, Jan 23rd at NOON! The application can be found in your email or via myCentral under Campus Life > Student Senate. 

Consider joining Senate if you want to be a student leader, make change on campus, and serve on faculty committees! HOORAH!

EnVision Vision Board Night

Join us for Vision Board Night and kick off the semester by creating your own vision board. All materials will be provided. We’ll be in the Maytag Atrium on Saturday, the 24th, from 7–9 PM . We can’t wait to see you there!
